purpose: Builds a deterministic Agent Guardrail Mandate skeleton from declared spend caps, MCC allowlist/blocklist, velocity rules, time windows, and approval thresholds. Stage 1 of the Agentic Policy Chain. The browser page additionally runs an interactive randomized synthetic-transaction simulator against the mandate for exploration; that non-deterministic step is a UI feature only and is not part of this server artifact's hashed output. Zero PII, client-side compute in the browser tool, deterministic server compute for MCP callers.
